description_en: Associates a virtual private cloud (VPC) with a Container Registry instance
description_zh: 为实例添加可访问实例的VPC实例
kebab_example: aliyun cr create-instance-vpc-endpoint-linked-vpc --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --vpc-id vpc-uf6pa68zxnnlc48dd0000 --vswitch-id vsw-uf6u0kn8x2gbzxfn20000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstanceVpcEndpointLinkedVpc

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch that is associated with the specified VPC
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the module that you want to access. Valid values:

`Registry`: image repositories.
`Chart`: Helm charts
parameters.help_zh:
设置访问的模块，取值：

`Registry`：访问镜像仓库。

`Chart`：访问Helm Chart
parameters.name: module_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically create Alibaba Cloud DNS PrivateZone records. Valid values:

If you enable automatic creation of PrivateZone records, a PrivateZone record is automatically created when you associate a VPC with the instance.

`true`
`false`
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动创建PrivateZone服务关联角色，取值：

如果您的账号下不存在PrivateZone服务关联角色，开启后会默认创建。

`true`：自动创建PrivateZone服务关联角色，并自动创建PrivateZone记录。

`false`：不自动创建PrivateZone服务关联角色。如果PrivateZone服务关联角色已存在，仍会自动创建PrivateZone记录
parameters.name: enable_create_dns_record_in_pvzt

IsSuccess.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful.

`true`: The request is successful.
`false`: The request fails
IsSuccess.description_zh:
调用是否成功
`true`：调用成功。
`false`：调用失败
